profile.summary: Lighthouse Community Public Schools is a nonprofit that runs public charter schools in Oakland, California, for students from transitional kindergarten through 12th grade. Its schools are Lighthouse and Lodestar, each with an elementary and a middle/high school campus. It also offers expanded learning programs, summer school, and college and career preparation.
